schema: Preserved failures and limitations; no history rewritten

corrections.fix: Create only private .git/info and resume successful init

corrections.failure: 612 explicit command arguments exceeded Windows process command length; baseline-add.json retains ENAMETOOLONG
corrections.fix: Explicit finite pathspec file, baseline-add-v2.json; no source reset or normalization; before-index blobs independently byte checked before patch

corrections.failure: UTF-8 argument-file launch on Windows did not start usable child; reading native error bytes as UTF-8 failed
corrections.fix: Actual ProcessBuilder separate argument vector; preserve initial XML/raw, do not count this as TLS functional RED

corrections.failure: Server accept waited after fail-closed scaffold never connected; parent server child deadline
corrections.fix: Finite 3s accept; next functional RED asserts TLS success=false with expected scaffold IOException; no fake success

corrections.failure: Port file existence raced its first write, two NumberFormatExceptions; H certificate handshake succeeded but subsequent ticket of 33021 bytes exceeded H
corrections.fix: Wait for nonempty port; equal tickets=0 startup for H/H+1 only; signed Certificate H passes and H+1 specific limit rejects
Test server uses its isolated root truststore, no system root dump; root-approved NST-only cap 1MiB; actual Produced10/Consumed10 then pass

corrections.failure: Accounting-overflow exception during conservative re-settlement prevented abort callback
corrections.fix: Always abort in finally, keep reservation charged; dedicated RED then focused GREEN and final

corrections.failure: Surefire user.dir is module; initial artifacts created under platform-gateway/.local/iam-o2b-f2a-tls/peers
corrections.fix: After all peers exited, finite validated PowerShell Move-Item of 47 directories/404 files with relocation map; final peers use verified absolute project root. Historical paths remain original

corrections.failure: Production raw lifecycle patch applied after failed thresholds compilation while its peer tests were still executing
corrections.fix: Archive original stage source.json as the epoch; its target-finite input-source hashes are late observations, not a byte-compiler assertion. Subsequent thresholds-fixed and final compile current full gateway bytes; no source edits during those stages

corrections.failure: 13 Windows Surefire Boot Manifest path diagnostics, each 344B, include suggestion to disable a JDK check
corrections.fix: Keep originals and separate diagnostic manifest; never apply that suggestion or rerun passing tests for noise

corrections.failure: Attribute check was repeated while repairing the failed initial private-baseline metadata setup
corrections.fix: No patch check/apply or successful tests repeated for packaging; first patch generation/check/apply and full 618 replay each executed once. First accepted612 verification was cached.
